finds.quote: In recently captured cases, Google Search correctly retrieves an entity and ranks its authoritative sources at the top of organic results, and Google's AI Overview nevertheless excludes those sources from composition — substituting a false or inferior entity frame for the user. The most recent formalization names this Entity-Level Compositional Suppression (ECS): the condition in which Google's organic search correctly resolves an entity while its AI Overview excludes that entity from the cited source set and composes a substitute answer.
finds.note: ECS stated as a standing claim about how Google AI Overview behaves; no falsifier in this deposit (it points to The Excluded Entity). Same line says the archive has documented the threshold "since late 2024" (internal chronology).

finds.quote: Argues that AI security taxonomies are converting external influence on machine meaning into attack by classifying origin rather than harm.
finds.falsifier_quote: Includes falsification conditions and a 24-month monitoring window.
finds.note: Summary of a registered forecast held in another deposit (#194); the map reports its falsifiers and 24-month window. Triage should link to #194.

finds.quote: Companion §8 "Horizon-Privatization Note" registers, as pre-registered hypothesis with explicit falsification conditions (§8.6), the interpretation that the recurring incognito-AI-disable-and-re-enable cycle is operationally consistent with stress-testing of personalized reality. The deposit's evidentiary weight rests on the operational consequence-identity (substrate withdrawal removes publicly inspectable surfaces); the interpretive weight rests on the motive-hypothesis, which the deposit holds open to falsification.
finds.note: Pre-registered hypothesis with falsification conditions (§8.6 of #149) that the incognito-AI disable/re-enable cycle is consistent with stress-testing of personalized reality; reported here, held in #149.

finds.quote: Specifies the methodology by which the canonicalization's effects on stabilized public-knowledge nodes (capitalism, Civil Rights Act, climate change, democracy) can be monitored across years, at proposition grain, with seven attribution classes distinguishing surface drift from mechanism attribution. v2.0 incorporates the central methodological correction that surface drift is directly observed while mechanism attribution is graded inference. Includes a named 12-week pilot (CHA-SNW-Pilot-01) with $38K–63K infrastructure budget and 20-week timeline.
finds.note: Named 12-week pilot with budget and timeline; specified, not reported as run.

finds.quote: This is not a slow drift. It is a phase transition with measurable parameters and predictable signatures. The finding establishes that policy targeting individual user behavior cannot address the dynamic; the parameter that matters is the population-scale mediation responsiveness, and it is approaching the critical region under existing conditions.

finds.quote: When platforms evaluate work for inclusion, ranking, or retrieval, work that comes from a single sustained author with deep provenance receives systematically lower scores than work assembled from many shallow sources — even when the substantive content is identical.
finds.note: Standing claim about evaluation behavior (glossary at 1491 calls it "Hypothesized"); no falsifier stated in this deposit.

finds.quote: The rate at which authorial provenance is erased in AI-generated content is power-conditioned: high-power source provenance is preserved at higher rates than low-power source provenance, in a manner that scales with substrate exposure.
finds.falsifier_quote: Replication procedure with falsifiability conditions documented in v3 §10.
finds.note: Standing claim that provenance erasure is power-conditioned; falsifiability conditions referenced to v3 §10.

finds.quote:
Google Scholar

Scholar suppression and citation-graph distortion operate on a different substrate from Search and AI Overviews but are subject to the same single-owner discount logic. The archive's 530+ DOI deposits are the natural test case.
